verdict.rationale: Datadog documents Bits AI, its own AI feature, and a first-party Experiments plugin for analyzing experiments in ChatGPT. Both suggest the product can be driven by natural language, but the pack only gives titles: it never describes which commands are supported or how far natural-language control extends. Missing for 10: documented detail on Bits AI natural-language commands, coverage beyond experiment analysis, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Analyze your experiments in ChatGPT with the Datadog Experiments plugin
